info.title: nxrs monitoring control API
info.description: Implemented v1 monitoring contract, with optional gateway-owned activity recording. Account authorization and opaque camera identities remain independent of VPN reachability. Fixtures contain no real credentials or footage.

servers.description: Illustrative enrolled origin; deployment may supply a base path.

200.description: Minimal process health, not camera or media health

429.description: Admission limit reached; do not retry immediately

201.description: Short-lived grant for exactly one authorized camera

404.description: Camera not found or not visible to this principal

429.description: Admission limit reached; do not retry immediately

get.summary: Subscribe to current detection state for an authorized camera

429.description: Admission limit reached; do not retry immediately

200.description: Bounded latest-state SSE, event detection. Revalidates camera authorization on every emission. Source and observation expiry produce unavailable; Last-Event-ID reports retention gaps, not durable alert replay.

404.description: Not found or subscription limit reached

accountBearer.description: Per-viewer account/device credential, independent of WireGuard.

availability.description: Gateway observation, not proof of fresh decoded video.

cameras.description: Only authorized cameras. Duplicate camera_id values are invalid.

endpoint.description: Enrolled media origin only. No userinfo, query, fragment, or embedded credentials.

access_token.description: Camera-scoped media credential, never the account or publisher credential. Redact from logs.

expires_at.description: Unix UTC seconds. Server issues at most 300 seconds ahead; server-side admission and active-session revocation are independent obligations.

ActivityEvent.description: Gateway-observed clip interval; end must be after start and at most 120 seconds later. Motion does not assert person identity. Kept events are exempt from automatic eviction.

ActivityProgress.description: Monotonic decoded-frame timings within one worker lifetime. A recovery spans the last frame before source retirement through the first recovered frame, including cleanup and retries. Initial acquisition is excluded. Observer run increments on worker restart; maxima and gap/recovery counts reset. Not sensor exposure or iPhone display latency.

ActivityHealth.description: Worker observation. Stale update/frame times must not be presented as confirmed monitoring.

Busy.description: Admission limit reached; do not retry immediately

NotFound.description: Unavailable activity, expired recording or hidden camera
